title: Saffire-IV
objective: Burn large samples aboard a Cygnus spacecraft to characterise fire growth and combustion products and to demonstrate fire detection and cleanup
fuel_material: SIBAL fabric (75 percent cotton and 25 percent fiberglass) and PMMA plastic
oxygen_value: 22.0 mol percent (tests IV-1 and IV-2 as executed)
apparatus: Saffire Flow Unit and Far Field Diagnostics on the Cygnus cargo vehicle
sensors: video cameras; gas sensors; remote CO2 and temperature sensors; particulate monitors
measurement_type: flame spread; combustion products (CO2 and CO); smoke particulates
notes: One NASA paper describes the burns as 21 percent O2 at one atmosphere while the executed test matrix lists 22.0 percent: confirm in PSI. Flow speed not found in retrieved sources (Saffire-I used 20 cm/s). Replace id with PSI ID and check whether a PSI dataset exists.

title: BASS-II
objective: Study ignition flame growth flame spread and extinction limits of solid fuels in low-velocity forced flows
fuel_material: PMMA sheets slabs spheres and cylinders; SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric
sample_shape_size: PMMA sheets 1 and 2 cm wide and 1 to 5 mm thick
oxygen_value: 16 to 21 percent by volume (reduced by nitrogen dilution)
apparatus: BASS flow duct (small wind tunnel) in the Microgravity Science Glovebox on the ISS
sensors: video camera; still camera; radiometer; oxygen and CO sensors; CO2 sensor
measurement_type: flame appearance; spread rate; extinction limits; heat release rate from O2 consumption
notes: Maximum flow speed differs between sources (40 or 53 or 55 cm/s): verify in the PSI record. Pressure 1 atm is stated for the fabric tests. Replace id with PSI ID.

title: SAME (and SAME-R)
objective: Measure smoke particle size distributions from overheated spacecraft materials to improve smoke detector design
fuel_material: Teflon; Kapton; cellulose; silicone rubber (SAME) and cotton; Pyrell (SAME-R)
apparatus: Microgravity Science Glovebox on the ISS (SAME on Expedition 15; SAME-R on Expedition 24)
sensors: ionization smoke detector; optical ISS smoke detector; particle counter; DustTrak; modified commercial detector; thermal precipitator for TEM grids
measurement_type: smoke particle size distribution moments; detector response
notes: Oxygen and pressure are not stated in retrieved sources. Sources note that air flow affects particle size below a threshold: find the values in PSI. DAFT shares an instrument but is a separate dust study.

title: FLEX
objective: Find the limiting oxygen index and extinction behaviour of burning fuel droplets diluted with CO2 or helium
apparatus: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA) in the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) on the ISS
measurement_type: droplet burning rate; extinction diameter; limiting oxygen index
notes: airflow_reported is no because droplets burned in still gas. Later FLEX work added more alkane fuels and more conditions. Replace id with PSI ID.

title: CFI-G
objective: Observe quasi-steady spherical cool flames of gaseous fuels on a porous burner
oxygen_value: Cool flames at 0.39 ambient oxygen mole fraction; oxidizer up to 85 percent oxygen per challenge brief
pressure_value: 2 bar for the cool flames (other pressures tested)
apparatus: ACME insert with an 83 L windowed pressure vessel in the CIR on the ISS
measurement_type: flame structure; cool flame occurrence; radiation; burner temperature
notes: Cool flames appeared only for normal n-butane flames at 2 bar. Pressure and flow rates for other tests were not retrieved. Replace id with PSI ID.
